story.heading: Gentle dental care, made for every smile.
story.body: We focus on patient comfort, transparent communication, and hygienic clinical standards. Whether you need a simple check-up or specialized care, our team ensures every visit is relaxed and stress-free.

faqs.q: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.a: You can click 'Book an appointment', call the clinic directly, or send us a message on WhatsApp for immediate assistance.

faqs.q: Do I need an appointment for a dental check-up?
faqs.a: Prior appointments are recommended to ensure zero waiting time, though walk-ins are accommodated based on doctor availability.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first consultation?
faqs.a: Please bring any previous dental X-rays or records if available, along with a list of any current medications.

faqs.q: Can I contact the clinic through WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes! You can message us on WhatsApp for slot availability, directions, and routine queries.
Our address and interactive map are listed below. We are located centrally with convenient local transit access.
Our clinic timings are displayed in the booking section below. Please call or message on WhatsApp to confirm holiday schedules.

faqs.q: Are treatment costs discussed before starting?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely. We provide a complete overview of recommended procedures and costs before starting any treatment.
